result.rationale: The migration runs `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` unconditionally. On sites where the `embed_category` site setting was never set (the common case, since it was just an optional setting defaulting to ''), no site_settings row exists, so the PG::Result is empty and `[0]` returns nil, making `['id']` raise NoMethodError and abort db:migrate. The code has no nil/empty guard (it only checks `category_id == 0` afterward, implying a fallback, but the crash occurs before that). Verifiable from the diff: `default: ''` for embed_category in the removed site_s
